_purpose: One command regenerates every scored comparison in the campaign. The correct flags differ per anchor -- which surface the runs are read as, which physics recipe to isolate, which material variant to compare against -- and remembering them by hand is how the wrong ones get used. Run: python3 python/score_anchors.py --plan validation/scoring_plan.json --runs runs
_why_recipe_matters: aplume+tv1 alone cannot separate the standing recipe from the REJECTED measured-absorptance arm; ereflct/iereflct are what distinguish them. Without the filter, a rejected arm pools into the shipped recipe's ladder.

anchors.label: Ti64 keyhole ladder (Gan 2021)
anchors.note: in-situ X-ray = vapour depression, NOT fusion; this is the manuscript keyhole figure

anchors.label: Ti64 transition-regime ladder at r0 60 um (THE manuscript figure)
anchors.note: metallographic fusion depth; bare 3mm plate; r0 60um is a RADIUS (D4sigma/2 of a stated 120um D4sigma). Fixed spot, power varied -- this is the ladder, kept separate from the defocus series below

anchors.label: Ti64 spot-size arm at r0 83 um (Galiegue defocus 5mm)
anchors.note: same power and speed as the 100W rung at a 1.4x larger spot; the middle rung of the three-point spot-size series (60/83/130 um) that tests whether the depth deficit is spot-size dependent

anchors.label: Ti64 spot-size arm at r0 130 um (Galiegue defocus 10mm)
anchors.note: same power and speed as the 100W rung but a 2.2x larger spot; the falsification test for the cavity-specific attribution

anchors.label: Ti64 slow-speed cross-check (Vaglio 2020)
anchors.note: r0 25um is UNVERIFIED (not in the dataset); do not use for spot-size response

anchors.label: CoCr (Appl. Sci. 16:5850)
anchors.note: cross-section metallography, means of 8 sections; widths are the paper's primary observable

anchors.label: SS304L spot welds (Hawk & Simonds 2022)
anchors.note: stationary spot welds, speed 0, 10ms dwell; 4 material variants differ up to 2x so the series MUST be named

_unscoreable.anchors/amb718_targets.json: keyed by stringified tuples; the reproducibility notebook indexes it by those keys, so converging the schema would break that consumer
_unscoreable.anchors/wang_cocr_targets.json: two named sweeps each with a _fixed block that must be merged into its points; not implemented

_why_r0_um: An anchor can hold a fixed-spot power ladder AND a defocus spot-size series. Pooling them mixes two experiments: the Galiegue mean of -48% spanned r0 60um rungs (-49..-63%) and an r0 130um point (-23%). Pin the radius so each entry is one experiment.
_provenance_note: Which conditions SELECTED the recipe and which were BLIND. The recipe carries one fitted scalar (tv1=3520 K, fitted on the Gan 129 W condition) and was frozen BEFORE the Galiegue, CoCr, SS304L and spot-size cases were run, so those cases test a fixed recipe.

selection.why: tv1=3520 K was fitted on this condition -- the recipe's ONLY free scalar

anchors/galiegue2025_ti64_targets.json.why: anchor extracted and cases run 2026-07-30, after the recipe was frozen

anchors/appsci_cocr_targets.json.why: nothing was calibrated on CoCr; first contact

anchors/hawk304l_targets.json.why: SS304L used its own database material; no condition here selected anything

anchors/amb718_targets.json.why: six IN718 conditions were consumed choosing the arm; the ONE blind test (s049, 49 um spot) failed at -25.2% and must be reported as such
